subject: food-technology

items.q: At what temperatures do bacteria multiply fastest?
items.why: Chilling (below 5°C) slows bacteria; thorough cooking (above 75°C) kills most; the danger zone is in between.

items.q: If food looks and smells fine, is it always safe?
items.correct: No — harmful bacteria often can't be seen, smelled or tasted.
items.misconception: Yes, fresh-looking food is always safe.
items.random_wrong: Reheating food many times is perfectly safe.
items.why: Use-by dates and proper storage matter because dangerous bacteria give no obvious signs.
